idle.note: the hero's cut-out bob: torso (with the harness and the crucible riding on it), head and both free arms drop 2 px and return as one rigid group; pelvis, belt, flap, legs and feet still

move.note: a heavy plod on the protagonist's model: both legs step, six stomping steps per tile rest to rest, the near foot leading; 5 px lift; the pelvis settles 3.5 px after each landing and the torso jolts 1 px on the four full-step landings; the crucible rides the torso; the fists swing 2 px; the loincloth flap trails 2 px

flap_sway._doc: added on top of flap.swing_deg: the flap sways with each step, trailing the pelvis settle

lob.note: sinks 4 px and leans in, then heaves up and back: the crucible tips 22 degrees over the shoulder toward the target and the slag is lobbed (contact; the existing lob mark); the fists pump 3 px with the heave, the arms riding the body; settles

land.note: as the slag lands far away the brute rocks forward 2 px and the emptied crucible rattles on its back (hold steps); a satisfied nod

brace.note: plants its feet and hunches behind its iron forearms: sinks 3 px, pitches forward 4 degrees with the chin tucked, and pulls both fists 4 px in toward the belly so the bracers close in front of the body; holds; releases

scatter.note: winds back, then heaves the crucible forward: it tips 14 degrees over the shoulder and spills a scatter of slag at the target (contact; the existing shot) as the torso drives into the throw and the near fist punches 4 px forward; settles

hit.note: spec hit: torso knocked 3 px back and 1 px down with a 3 degree lean back, head nods back 3 degrees, both hands trail 1 px; recovered by 0.6

death.note: sags to its knees: the pelvis drops 12 px over planted feet, the torso pitches forward 14 degrees with the crucible tipping a further 10 degrees over its head, the head bows 3 degrees more, the fists sink with the body; terminal pose held, then the existing fade
